title: uniflow pipeline parameters
description: RNA + DNA co-sequencing pipeline parameters for Nextflow (nf-core style JSON Schema)

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: Protocol describing barcode/UMI structure for STARsolo.

solofeature.title: STARsolo feature
solofeature.description: Feature for STARsolo quantification (e.g., GeneFull, Gene, SJ).

star_index.title: STAR genome index path
star_index.description: Filesystem path to STAR genome index directory.

outdir.title: Output directory
outdir.description: Filesystem path to the output directory.

experiment_id.title: Experiment directory
experiment_id.description: Name for experiment directory. Must have date and JIRA id in format <date>_<RAR-123>_<any-descriptive-name>
experiment_id.errorMessage: Experiment ID must be in format <date>_<RAR-123>_<any-descriptive-name>, e.g., 20240101_RAR-123_experiment-name

amplicon_fasta.title: Amplicon targets FASTA
amplicon_fasta.description: Filesystem path to FASTA with amplicon targets used for DNA alignment/counting.

trimming_length.title: Trimming length
trimming_length.description: Length to trim reads to for RNA alignment (e.g., 100).

product_id.title: Product ID
product_id.description: Product ID used to select whitelist files (e.g., B4_24_v1 or B4_96_v1).

disable_validation.title: Disable input validation
disable_validation.description: When true, disables INPUT_VALIDATION workflow. This is not recommended unless you are confident in your inputs.

internal.title: Internal flag
internal.description: Indicates whether this is an internal run or a customer run.

input_csv.title: Samplesheet CSV
input_csv.description: CSV with columns: library_name, library_type (RNA/DNA), protocol_version, fastq_1, fastq_2, [optional] demultiplexing_indices
input_csv.errorMessage: The input must be a valid CSV file path with no spaces, ending in '.csv', and must exist.

variant_calling.title: Variant calling specific options
variant_calling.description: Parameters controlling the bulk variant-calling subworkflow on amplicon BAMs.

run_variant_calling.title: Run variant calling flag
run_variant_calling.description: When false, no DNA sample runs the variant-calling subworkflow. The per-sample 'run_variant_calling' samplesheet column overrides this default.

variant_callers.title: Variant caller list
variant_callers.description: Comma-separated list of variant callers to run. Accepted values are 'freebayes', 'bcftools', 'vardict', 'deepvariant', and 'gatkhc'. ('lofreq' is still wired through but excluded from the default — its site-only output lacks FORMAT/AD,DP so it does not contribute to the consensus FORMAT-derived summaries until an INFO→FORMAT lift is implemented.) To disable variant calling entirely, set 'run_variant_calling: false' instead of an empty value. Subsetting permitted.
variant_callers.errorMessage: variant_callers must be a comma-separated, non-empty list of values from [freebayes, lofreq, bcftools, vardict, deepvariant, gatkhc] (e.g. 'freebayes,lofreq'). No trailing comma. To disable variant calling, set 'run_variant_calling: false' instead.

amplicon_bed.title: Amplicon target BED
amplicon_bed.description: Optional target BED for callers that require regions (VarDict, GATK_HC, DeepVariant). When null, derived once from amplicon_fasta via BEDTOOLS_MAKEWINDOWS (one record per contig, full-length interval). When set, the supplied BED is used directly.

gq_calibration.title: Genotype-quality calibration source
gq_calibration.description: Whether this sample has its own ground-truth VCF. The beta-binomial overdispersion rho, and therefore every per-cell GQ, cannot be estimated without a truth set, so a sample without one inherits the constant calibrated on a reference run and its GQ is optimistic by however much this sample is more overdispersed. GT and outlier_lod are unaffected either way. Use 'truth-calibrated' only when the sample has its own donor VCF; a declared target list does not qualify. This is a declaration the data cannot settle, so it is set per launch rather than in conf/variant.config, and it is read only by the detection-power report.
gq_calibration.errorMessage: gq_calibration must be either 'inherited' (the sample has no ground-truth VCF, which is every production run) or 'truth-calibrated' (the sample has its own donor VCF and rho was calibrated on it).

downsampling.title: Read downsampling options
downsampling.description: CB-aware per-(cell, amplicon) read downsampling. Enabled by default; set per_cell_per_amplicon_downsample=false to restore the full-depth baseline.

per_cell_per_amplicon_downsample.title: Per-(cell, amplicon) downsampling
per_cell_per_amplicon_downsample.description: When true (default), applies a CB-aware per-(cell, amplicon) cap (keep-list + samtools view -N) to the variant-layer BAM (discovery + per-cell); counts/cells stay at full depth. Set false to disable and keep the variant-layer BAM at full depth.

downsample_reads_per_cell_amplicon.title: Per-(cell, amplicon) read cap
downsample_reads_per_cell_amplicon.description: Maximum reads kept per (cell, amplicon) when per_cell_per_amplicon_downsample is true; cell-amplicons with fewer reads are kept whole. Also the candidate cap N marked on the coverage QC.

downsample_seed.title: Downsampling seed
downsample_seed.description: Fixed seed for reproducible sampling (the per-cell keep-list draw).
